bio: The Pinnacle Mortgage Solutions site (note the spelling: pinnaclemortgagesolutions.ca, not the sheet's pinnaclemortgagessolutions.ca) currently returns 404 on its pages, so only the footer text was captured. It lists Keaton Thornton as Agent Level 1 at 226.450.4216 serving Ancaster to Woodstock, under Mortgage Alliance (licence #10530). jimthornton.ca is a separate Assante wealth-advisor site for Jim Thornton in Brantford.

brokerage.name: The Mortgage Alliance Company of Canada (Pinnacle Mortgage Solutions is a team under it)

reviews.source: Birdeye listing for Jim Thornton (search result, unverified)

notes: Sheet domain pinnaclemortgagessolutions.ca does not resolve (DNS). Real domain pinnaclemortgagesolutions.ca: robots.txt allows crawl but / and /about/ return 404; menu links use ?page_id=N (also 404 for fetch). krtmortgages.ca has an SSL hostname mismatch (not fetched).

Site footer says Mortgage Alliance #10530; clients.json says RMA (Real Mortgage Associates). Search (check) says RMA brokerage licence 10464 and that Keaton is Jim's son; Jim mortgage-brokering since 2004 via RMA and Assante wealth advisor since Oct 2018.

jimthornton.ca: 'Financial Advisor in Brantford - Assante Capital Management' at 105 George St., Brantford ON N3T 2Y5; its cell 905.921.1805 matches clients.json Jim phone. This is a securities/wealth site, not mortgage; do not use for mortgage compliance line.

Directory (check): Birdeye shows Jim Thornton 5-star from 17 reviews: https://reviews.birdeye.com/jim-thornton-mortgage-broker-real-mortgage-associates-168329257690407 ; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/KeatonThorntonRMA/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/pinnaclemortgagesolutions.ca/ appear in search only (not opened).
Licence numbers M22000917 / M08002211 from clients.json not found on any fetched page.
